INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog_summary (summary_key,value_int,updated_at)
      SELECT 'rebuild_dirty_since', 0, ?

SELECT summary_key, value_int FROM catalog_summary
        WHERE summary_key IN ('rebuild_generation', 'rebuild_applied_generation', 'rebuild_last_at',
                              'rebuild_last_attempt_at', 'rebuild_lease_until',
                              'rebuild_last_mutation_at', 'rebuild_dirty_since')
DELETE FROM aggregate_court_year_outcome
DELETE FROM aggregate_visa
DELETE FROM aggregate_country
DELETE FROM aggregate_judge
DELETE FROM aggregate_judge_court
DELETE FROM aggregate_nature_outcome
DELETE FROM aggregate_source

DELETE FROM catalog_summary WHERE summary_key NOT IN ('rebuild_generation', 'rebuild_applied_generation', 'rebuild_last_at', 'rebuild_last_attempt_at', 'rebuild_lease_until', 'rebuild_last_mutation_at', 'rebuild_dirty_since', 'rebuild_day', 'rebuild_count_today')
DELETE FROM aggregate_concept
DELETE FROM aggregate_scope
DELETE FROM aggregate_court_nature_outcome
DELETE FROM aggregate_concept_scope
DELETE FROM aggregate_concept_pair
DELETE FROM aggregate_judge_outcome
DELETE FROM aggregate_judge_year
DELETE FROM aggregate_judge_visa
DELETE FROM filter_options

INSERT INTO aggregate_court_year_outcome (court_code,year,outcome,case_count,updated_at)
        SELECT court_code, year, outcome, COUNT(*), ? FROM cases GROUP BY court_code, year, outcome

INSERT INTO aggregate_source (source,case_count,updated_at)
        SELECT source, COUNT(*), ? FROM cases WHERE source <> '' GROUP BY source

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key,value_int,updated_at)
        SELECT 'total_cases', COUNT(*), ? FROM cases

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key,value_int,updated_at)
        SELECT 'with_full_text', COUNT(*), ? FROM cases WHERE content_key <> ''

INSERT INTO aggregate_judge_court (judge_id,court_code,case_count)
        SELECT cj.judge_id, c.court_code, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.case_id)
        FROM case_judges cj JOIN cases c ON c.case_id = cj.case_id
        WHERE c.court_code <> '' GROUP BY cj.judge_id, c.court_code

INSERT INTO aggregate_nature_outcome (case_nature,outcome,case_count)
        SELECT case_nature, outcome, COUNT(*) FROM cases WHERE case_nature <> '' GROUP BY case_nature, outcome

INSERT INTO aggregate_concept (concept_id,label,case_count)
        SELECT cc.concept_id, c.label, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.case_id)
        FROM case_concepts cc JOIN concepts c ON c.concept_id = cc.concept_id GROUP BY cc.concept_id, c.label

INSERT INTO aggregate_country (country,case_count,updated_at)
        SELECT country_of_origin, COUNT(*), ? FROM cases WHERE country_of_origin <> '' GROUP BY country_of_origin

INSERT INTO aggregate_judge (judge_id,canonical_name,case_count,updated_at)
        SELECT j.judge_id, j.canonical_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.case_id), ?
        FROM judges j JOIN case_judges cj ON cj.judge_id = j.judge_id GROUP BY j.judge_id, j.canonical_name

INSERT INTO aggregate_visa (visa_subclass,court_code,outcome,case_count,updated_at)
        SELECT visa_subclass, court_code, outcome, COUNT(*), ? FROM cases
        WHERE visa_subclass <> '' GROUP BY visa_subclass, court_code, outcome

INSERT INTO aggregate_scope
        (court_code,year,outcome,visa_subclass,visa_type,source,case_nature,country_of_origin,has_full_text,case_count)
        SELECT COALESCE(court_code,''), COALESCE(year,0), COALESCE(outcome,''), COALESCE(visa_subclass,''),
               COALESCE(visa_type,''), COALESCE(source,''), COALESCE(case_nature,''), COALESCE(country_of_origin,''),
               CASE WHEN content_key <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COUNT(*)
        FROM cases GROUP BY COALESCE(court_code,''), COALESCE(year,0), COALESCE(outcome,''), COALESCE(visa_subclass,''),
          COALESCE(visa_type,''), COALESCE(source,''), COALESCE(case_nature,''), COALESCE(country_of_origin,''),
          CASE WHEN content_key <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

INSERT INTO aggregate_court_nature_outcome (court_code,case_nature,outcome,case_count)
        SELECT court_code, case_nature, outcome, COUNT(*) FROM cases WHERE case_nature <> ''
        GROUP BY court_code, case_nature, outcome

INSERT INTO aggregate_concept_scope (concept_id,court_code,year,outcome,case_count)
        SELECT cc.concept_id, c.court_code, COALESCE(c.year,0), c.outcome, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.case_id)
        FROM case_concepts cc JOIN cases c ON c.case_id = cc.case_id
        GROUP BY cc.concept_id, c.court_code, COALESCE(c.year,0), c.outcome

INSERT INTO aggregate_concept_pair
        (concept_id_a,concept_id_b,court_code,outcome,case_count)
        SELECT a.concept_id, b.concept_id, c.court_code, c.outcome, COUNT(DISTINCT a.case_id)
        FROM case_concepts a JOIN case_concepts b ON b.case_id = a.case_id AND a.concept_id < b.concept_id
        JOIN cases c ON c.case_id = a.case_id
        GROUP BY a.concept_id, b.concept_id, c.court_code, c.outcome

INSERT INTO aggregate_judge_outcome (judge_id,court_code,outcome,case_count)
        SELECT cj.judge_id, c.court_code, c.outcome, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.case_id)
        FROM case_judges cj JOIN cases c ON c.case_id = cj.case_id
        GROUP BY cj.judge_id, c.court_code, c.outcome

INSERT INTO aggregate_judge_year (judge_id,year,case_count)
        SELECT cj.judge_id, c.year, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.case_id)
        FROM case_judges cj JOIN cases c ON c.case_id = cj.case_id WHERE c.year IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY cj.judge_id, c.year

INSERT INTO aggregate_judge_visa (judge_id,visa_subclass,case_count)
        SELECT cj.judge_id, c.visa_subclass, COUNT(DISTINCT cj.case_id)
        FROM case_judges cj JOIN cases c ON c.case_id = cj.case_id WHERE c.visa_subclass <> ''
        GROUP BY cj.judge_id, c.visa_subclass

INSERT INTO filter_options (filter_name, option_value, sort_order)
        SELECT ?, CAST(court_code AS TEXT), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY court_code) - 1
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT court_code FROM cases WHERE court_code IS NOT NULL AND court_code <> '')

INSERT INTO filter_options (filter_name, option_value, sort_order)
        SELECT ?, CAST(year AS TEXT), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY year) - 1
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT year FROM cases WHERE year IS NOT NULL AND year <> '')

INSERT INTO filter_options (filter_name, option_value, sort_order)
        SELECT ?, CAST(outcome AS TEXT), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY outcome) - 1
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT outcome FROM cases WHERE outcome IS NOT NULL AND outcome <> '')

INSERT INTO filter_options (filter_name, option_value, sort_order)
        SELECT ?, CAST(visa_type AS TEXT), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY visa_type) - 1
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT visa_type FROM cases WHERE visa_type IS NOT NULL AND visa_type <> '')

INSERT INTO filter_options (filter_name, option_value, sort_order)
        SELECT ?, CAST(visa_subclass AS TEXT), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY visa_subclass) - 1
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT visa_subclass FROM cases WHERE visa_subclass IS NOT NULL AND visa_subclass <> '')

INSERT INTO filter_options (filter_name, option_value, sort_order)
        SELECT ?, CAST(source AS TEXT), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY source) - 1
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT source FROM cases WHERE source IS NOT NULL AND source <> '')

INSERT INTO filter_options (filter_name, option_value, sort_order)
        SELECT ?, CAST(case_nature AS TEXT), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY case_nature) - 1
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT case_nature FROM cases WHERE case_nature IS NOT NULL AND case_nature <> '')

INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog_summary (summary_key,value_int,updated_at)
        SELECT 'rebuild_applied_generation', ?, ?

INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog_summary (summary_key,value_int,updated_at)
        SELECT 'rebuild_last_at', ?, ?

INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog_summary (summary_key,value_int,updated_at)
        SELECT 'rebuild_dirty_since', 0, ?

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
          VALUES ('rebuild_generation', 1, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(summary_key) DO UPDATE SET value_int = catalog_summary.value_int + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
          VALUES ('rebuild_last_mutation_at', ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(summary_key) DO UPDATE SET
          value_int = MAX(catalog_summary.value_int, excluded.value_int), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
          VALUES ('rebuild_dirty_since', ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(summary_key) DO UPDATE SET
          value_int = CASE WHEN catalog_summary.value_int = 0 THEN excluded.value_int ELSE catalog_summary.value_int END,
          updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
          VALUES ('rebuild_generation', 1, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(summary_key) DO UPDATE SET value_int = catalog_summary.value_int + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
          VALUES ('rebuild_last_mutation_at', ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(summary_key) DO UPDATE SET
          value_int = MAX(catalog_summary.value_int, excluded.value_int), updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
          VALUES ('rebuild_dirty_since', ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(summary_key) DO UPDATE SET
          value_int = CASE WHEN catalog_summary.value_int = 0 THEN excluded.value_int ELSE catalog_summary.value_int END,
          updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
          VALUES ('rebuild_count_today', 1, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(summary_key) DO UPDATE SET
          value_int = CASE
            WHEN (SELECT value_int FROM catalog_summary WHERE summary_key = 'rebuild_day') = ?
            THEN catalog_summary.value_int + 1
            ELSE 1 END,
          updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
          VALUES ('rebuild_day', ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(summary_key) DO UPDATE SET value_int = excluded.value_int,
          updated_at = excluded.updated_at
SELECT value_int FROM catalog_summary WHERE summary_key = 'rebuild_count_today'

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
          VALUES ('rebuild_count_today', 1, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(summary_key) DO UPDATE SET
          value_int = CASE
            WHEN (SELECT value_int FROM catalog_summary WHERE summary_key = 'rebuild_day') = ?
            THEN catalog_summary.value_int + 1
            ELSE 1 END,
          updated_at = excluded.updated_at

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
          VALUES ('rebuild_day', ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(summary_key) DO UPDATE SET value_int = excluded.value_int,
          updated_at = excluded.updated_at
SELECT value_int FROM catalog_summary WHERE summary_key = 'rebuild_count_today'

SELECT summary_key, value_int FROM catalog_summary
        WHERE summary_key IN ('rebuild_generation', 'rebuild_applied_generation', 'rebuild_last_at',
                              'rebuild_last_attempt_at', 'rebuild_lease_until',
                              'rebuild_last_mutation_at', 'rebuild_dirty_since')

INSERT INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
        VALUES ('rebuild_lease_until', ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(summary_key) DO UPDATE SET value_int = excluded.value_int, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
      WHERE catalog_summary.value_int < ?

INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog_summary (summary_key, value_int, updated_at)
        VALUES ('rebuild_last_attempt_at', ?, ?)

UPDATE catalog_summary SET value_int = ?, updated_at = ?
        WHERE summary_key = 'rebuild_lease_until' AND updated_at = ?

UPDATE catalog_summary SET value_int = 0, updated_at = ?
        WHERE summary_key = 'rebuild_lease_until' AND updated_at = ?
